secrets.name: CRYPTOCOMPARE_API_KEY
secrets.description: CoinDesk (CryptoCompare) API key, used server-side by the /api/crypto proxy for the BTC/ETH/USDT rates. A value is stored but the provider does not recognise it (401 API key required, tested with both the Authorization header and the api_key query parameter), so the real key from the CryptoCompare account page is needed before those three rows fill in. The fiat (USD/EUR/gold) rows need no key. Optional for boot.
